objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to lifecycle control including creation, release, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code identifier with consecutive number (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period the document is retained after invalidation before physical deletion.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled supplementary document that follows the release cycle of its main document and triggers a new version upon creation, modification, or archiving.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status mirroring the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object not subject to the release cycle, published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing document, managed independently of the document's version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, processed via workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated document, created only by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who can act in one or more roles within the document management process.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read, write, or acknowledgement authorizations to documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type or purpose of the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A per-document list of user groups and persons controlling email notification and acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A structured process instance supporting approval steps such as creator sign-off, review, and release.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow instance.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must pass its own review and release workflow.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Target language of the translation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the translated version.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client and office component.

evts.name: edit_metadata
evts.description: Document properties and metadata attributes are maintained or updated.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF format after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature of the author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of review (technical or formal).

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: Outcome of the review (approved or rejected).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication and distribution to readers.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature of the releaser.

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: Outcome of the release decision (approved or rejected).

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling it for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The document is automatically made visible to addressed readers after release.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision.

attributes.name: new_version
attributes.description: The new version number assigned.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment object is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting its version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by any user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the resolution of a change proposal, which is then no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or full release chain) confirms continued validity, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The override request is approved through the workflow, setting the document status to out of force.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: All authorizations except archive group are revoked and the document enters the archive period.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The reactivation is confirmed, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read or write).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document's content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language the document is translated into.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is reviewed and released via its own workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature for the translation release.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main document.
Additional information is supplementary to a document without affecting its version.
A change proposal is created for and belongs to a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
An override request targets a specific document for invalidation.
A reactivation request references the specific archived document to be reactivated.
A distribution list is maintained per document to control notification and acknowledgement.
User groups are assigned to a document's distribution list.
Users are members of user groups which determine their authorizations and roles.
A translation is a language-dependent version of an original released document.
A workflow instance is associated with a document for release, validity extension, override, or reactivation processing.
Documents can reference other documents via the references attribute.
